messages:
sarah_marketing: quick sync — we need final visuals for the benchmark narrative and webinar deck by Friday. two priority charts: 1) latency vs cost curve (p50/p95 lines + p99 callout) across host/dedicated/private variants; 2) per-request cost breakdown stacked by model variant + quantization level. also need a 2-sentence headline and one short CTA for the landing page.

david_bench: I can pull the runs and generate the curves. which specific model family and endpoints should be on the x-axis? cost per token or cost per 1k tokens? host vs dedicated on separate lines?

sarah_marketing: make x-axis request size (tokens) and show cost-per-1k-tokens on secondary axis. include host / dedicated / private as separate colored lines. we want both absolute cost and normalized percent savings vs baseline.

emily_design: for visuals — prefer 16:9 slides. accessible palette (colorblind-safe), big labels, and callout bubbles for the quantization points. do we want shaded latency bands for load variance?

odivia_data: methodology notes: use the March 18–20 runs (stable infra), batch size distribution 1–8, measure p50/p95/p99 latencies and cost math from billing sim. annotate when caching/batching contributed. hide single-run noise but surface p99 as a small dot/annotation. units: ms for latency, $/1k tokens for cost.

david_bench: plan: export aggregated CSV then script to plot. sample command: ```python tools/plot_bench.py --input runs/2026-03-18.json --models gptx-small,gptx-medium --variants host,dedicated,private --percentiles p50,p95,p99 --output figs/latency_cost.png``` will attach figs here when done.

emily_design: I'll make two variants: slide-ready (clean axis, annotations) and social-card (simplified headline + single curve). want the headline text now to design typographic hierarchy.

sarah_marketing: draft headline attempt: "Predictable latency, lower unit cost — Redwood's routing and batching shrink per-token spend without surprising tail latency." feedback?

odivia_data: tweak: mention percent: "Reduce per-token cost up to 40% while holding p95 latency within X ms" — but we must only claim numbers we can back. We have ~35% int8 gains on avg across our test set; p95 uplift is <10% in most cases.

aaron_gtm: operational ask: on the webinar landing form, route inbound leads with checkbox options: Interested in Hosted / Dedicated / Private. tag leads with 'benchmark_webinar' and if they check Dedicated or Private, route to Enterprise SDR queue.

sarah_marketing: good — Aaron can you add the lead routing snippet to the GH form? we also need the one-line CTA for the slide footer e.g., "See full methodology + request a cost model" — okay?

benchmark-bot: export complete: runs/2026-03-18-agg.csv uploaded to //artifacts/benchmarks/1780001234/runs.csv (sha256: ab12...ef34).

david_bench: grabbing the artifact now. will post first drafts (charts + raw numbers) by 18:00 PT today.

emily_design: will drop mockups in #marketing-design and link here. planning two colorways: coral/teal and navy/gold.

sarah_marketing: perfect. once we have charts, i'll craft the 2-sentence narrative + landing copy. final checklist: visuals (david/emily), methodology blurb (olivia), lead routing (aaron), headline + CTA (sarah). thanks :raised_hands:
